adds.rationale: CareTrust REIT is actively deploying equity-funded capital into skilled-nursing and seniors-housing real estate, giving the watchlist the eldercare-REIT exposure the thesis names explicitly but that ISRG (surgical robotics, not real estate) does not capture.

news_evidence.summary: CareTrust REIT closed $45 million of new investments in skilled nursing and seniors housing facilities.
CareTrust reported Q2 2023 results: 96% of $215.4 million invested year-to-date was equity-funded (no incremental leverage), and the board declared a $0.28/share quarterly dividend.

removes.rationale: NuScale's flagship Carbon Free Power Project — the near-term commercial proof point for the SMR thesis — is running well short of the subscription level it needs to survive, with a hard February 2024 deadline four months away and no fresh commitments surfacing this quarter.

news_evidence.summary: NuScale raised the CFPP target power price 53% to $89/MWh as the project's construction cost estimate jumped 75% to $9.3 billion.
26 of 27 UAMPS participants voted to continue the CFPP, but committed subscription stood at only ~120 MWe of the 370 MWe required (~32%), with an 80% subscription threshold due by February 1, 2024.

rationale_overall: Most of the current watchlist re-confirmed its thesis this quarter with clean Q2 2023 prints: NVDA (+101% YoY revenue), MSFT/GOOGL (cloud and AI-driven beats), RKLB (revenue +12% YoY, 10 new launch contracts, raised Q3 guidance), IONQ (record $28M bookings), LMT (net sales +8%, F-35 Lot 17 orders), ISRG (da Vinci procedures +22% YoY), STNG ($132M net income), CCJ (long-term contracts growing), and LEU (HALEU demonstration cascade completed) all argue for staying the course, so I left them untouched. The one clear swap trims SMR — whose flagship UAMPS reactor project is materially behind the subscription level it needs with a hard deadline four months out and construction costs already up 75% — and replaces it with CTRE, giving the demographics wave the eldercare-REIT exposure the profile names explicitly, which ISRG's surgical-robotics business does not provide. Planet Labs' September 7 print and UEC's August acquisition were read but neither cleared the bar. The watchlist stays at the 16-ticker cap.
